chunks: God decides with justice. But those they call apart from Him can not adjudge in the least. Verily God is all-hearing, all-perceiving.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between God's judgment and the judgment of false gods according to Surah Ghafir?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Tawhid al-Hukm* (Oneness of Sovereignty), distinguishing Allah’s absolute, decisive judgment from the impotence of idols or false authorities. It serves as a theological refutation of polytheism by highlighting that while created beings may be invoked, only the Creator possesses the power to enact verdicts, reinforcing His attributes of *As-Sami'* and *Al-Basir* as witnesses to all hidden and apparent matters.
